posts.text: put me in a book club and i'll be the sagittarius who read the first chapter, has a fully formed philosophy about the ending, and is confidently, passionately wrong about it
posts.caption: Jupiter expands the confidence, not the reading

posts.text: i regret to inform my sagittarius moon that we cannot simply leave every room the moment it gets emotionally complicated. that said, i am already in the car x
posts.caption: Emotional exit strategy: always parked out front

posts.text: pull me aside at airport security and i'll be the sagittarius asking the officer where he'd go if he could go anywhere, and by the end of the bag check we've both quit our jobs
posts.caption: Randomly selected for a life-changing conversation

posts.text: please be advised that my sagittarius placements have been formally asked to stop opening sentences with 'no offence but.' we have agreed to replace it with 'respectfully,' which does exactly the same thing
posts.caption: Same honesty, new packaging

posts.text: invite me to give the wedding toast and i'll be the sagittarius who opens with 'i genuinely did not think this would last' and somehow gets a standing ovation
posts.caption: Brutal honesty, impeccable timing

posts.text: very sagittarius venus of me to want a deep, committed, soul-level connection with someone who never once asks what i'm doing next weekend
posts.caption: Love me freely, schedule me never

posts.text: put me in a hostage negotiation and i'll be the sagittarius convincing the guy that life is too short for this, he really needs to see patagonia, and honestly, i'll drive
posts.caption: Jupiter optimism as a crisis strategy

posts.text: and here, in its natural habitat, we observe the wild sagittarius. it has made three plans for tonight, will attend a fourth, and the original group chat will not hear from it until thursday
posts.caption: Rarely seen, frequently overbooked

posts.text: by entering a friendship with a sagittarius you agree to the following terms: spontaneous road trips, unsolicited honesty, and at least one story a month that begins 'so i got lost again, but listen'
posts.caption: Read the fine print. They lost it.

posts.text: i regret to announce that i have once again joined a project with full sagittarius enthusiasm and approximately none of the attention span required to finish it. we wish the project well x
posts.caption: Mutable fire: great at starting, legendary at moving on

posts.text: having a sagittarius rising means i can befriend an entire hostel in one night and still be unreachable by the people who have known me for ten years
posts.caption: Great first impression, terrible reply time

posts.text: take me to a museum and i'll be the sagittarius who reads one plaque about ancient greece and immediately books a one-way ticket to athens to 'understand the context'
posts.caption: Jupiter said go, so they went

posts.text: very on brand that the sagittarius symbol is half human, half horse, because half of me wants to discuss the meaning of life and the other half has already bolted out the door
posts.caption: The philosopher stayed. The horse did not.

posts.text: your honour, my sagittarius client did not 'ghost' the plaintiff. they simply went on a spiritual journey to find themselves and lost signal for six to eight weeks
posts.caption: The defence rests. In Bali.

posts.text: as a sagittarius i would like to formally thank jupiter for all the luck that has repeatedly saved me from consequences i absolutely walked into with my eyes wide open
posts.caption: Ruled by the planet of luck and it shows

posts.text: put me in a candlelit restaurant on a first date and i'll be the capricorn gently asking about his five-year plan, his pension contributions, and whether he has ever finished a hobby
posts.caption: Romance is a long-term investment

posts.text: please note that my capricorn moon processes feelings exclusively through a quarterly review. your concerns have been logged and will be addressed in q3, pending budget approval x
posts.caption: Emotions are on the agenda. Under any other business.

posts.text: drop me into a heist movie and i'll be the capricorn who isn't there for the thrill. i built the timeline, booked the van, and i will be invoicing everyone afterwards
posts.caption: Someone has to run the logistics

posts.text: very capricorn of me to take a holiday and spend the first two days building an itinerary so efficient that the actual relaxing is scheduled for 3:15 to 3:40
posts.caption: Rest, but make it billable

posts.text: i regret to announce that as a capricorn i was born approximately 52 years old and have been aging backwards ever since. by retirement i fully expect to be a delight
posts.caption: Saturn front-loads the hard part

posts.text: ask me to give a wedding toast and i'll be the capricorn who thanks the vendors by name, notes we are running eleven minutes behind, then says one sentence so sincere the whole room cries
posts.caption: Dry for four minutes, devastating for one

posts.text: put me in a dmv queue and i'll be the capricorn who arrived with every form pre-filled, two copies of everything, and was quietly helping the staff by the second hour
posts.caption: Bureaucracy has never been so afraid

posts.text: having a venus in capricorn means i don't say i love you. i say i've set up a joint savings account, sorted your car insurance and put your mum's birthday in my calendar
posts.caption: Their love language is admin, honestly

posts.text: by royal decree of the capricorn sun, all fun is hereby approved, provided it is scheduled in advance, comes in under budget, and finishes in time for an early night
posts.caption: Fun has been permitted. Within reason.

posts.text: three weeks into the new job and the actual manager has started asking me what we should do next. as a capricorn i'd love to say i didn't plan this. i did
posts.caption: Corporate ladder? Mountain goat, actually

posts.text: if i'm ever called as a witness, i'll be the capricorn who brings dated receipts, a full timeline of events, and a binder labelled 'for when they inevitably lie'
posts.caption: The prosecution would like to hire them

posts.text: here we see the capricorn, mountain goat of the zodiac, slowly scaling a sheer cliff of responsibilities while everyone below shouts up asking if it ever takes a weekend off
posts.caption: It does not. It is building equity.

posts.text: a capricorn rising will walk into a party, say almost nothing, and still leave with three people asking for career advice and one asking if they're secretly the host
posts.caption: Quiet authority is a placement

posts.text: terms and conditions of being loved by a capricorn: dry humour, terrifying loyalty, and a partner who treats your wildest dream like a project plan that just needs a deadline x
posts.caption: They will believe in you aggressively

posts.text: a mars in capricorn doesn't get angry. it gets quiet, makes a plan, and five years later you find out it bought the building
posts.caption: Revenge, but make it a long-term asset

posts.text: put me at a family dinner and i'll be the aquarius who skipped the small talk, asked grandma her views on universal basic income, and started a debate that ends at midnight
posts.caption: Nobody passed the potatoes. Everybody passed judgement.

posts.text: as an aquarius i will march for the rights of eight billion strangers and then quietly leave a group chat of four because someone sent a voice note
posts.caption: Humanitarian, but not like that

posts.text: your honour, my aquarius client did not 'emotionally detach' from the relationship. they simply observed it from a safe scientific distance and wrote up their findings
posts.caption: Peer review is still pending, unfortunately

posts.text: very aquarius moon of me to respond to someone's heartfelt confession with 'okay, let's look at this logically' and then wonder why the room got colder
posts.caption: Fixed air: excellent logic, room temperature hugs

posts.text: if aliens ever land i'll be the aquarius at the front of the crowd, not to welcome them, but to ask why it took so long and whether they're hiring
posts.caption: Finally, some people who get it

posts.text: i regret to announce that my aquarius placements have stopped liking a band i discovered first, because you all like it now. we are exploring a finnish accordion collective instead x
posts.caption: It was better before you heard it

posts.text: dating an aquarius is wonderful. we'll stay up until 4am discussing time travel and the nature of consciousness, then i'll reply to 'good morning' three business days later
posts.caption: Intimacy of the mind, latency of the inbox

posts.text: by royal decree of the aquarius, the following are now banned in my kingdom: dress codes, small talk, anyone who says 'that's how it's always been done' and, effective immediately, the monarchy
posts.caption: Abolished themselves by lunchtime

posts.text: and here we observe the aquarius at a house party, standing slightly apart from the herd, two hours deep in conversation with the host's cat, the only guest it considers an original thinker
posts.caption: Selective socialising in the wild

posts.text: put me in a corporate brainstorm and i'll be the aquarius who pitches an idea so far ahead of its time that it gets rejected now and stolen in 2031
posts.caption: Uranus energy, unfortunately unpatented

posts.text: people forget aquarius is ruled by saturn as well as uranus, which is why i will passionately reject every rule society has ever made and then strictly enforce my own
posts.caption: Rebel with a very specific rulebook

posts.text: having a venus in aquarius means the most romantic thing you can do is be my best friend first, my partner second, and absolutely never ask what we are
posts.caption: Don't label it. They'll leave.

posts.text: seat me at a wedding and i'll be the aquarius explaining to the bride's uncle that marriage is a social construct, and then giving the most moving toast of the night
posts.caption: Against tradition, for love, somehow

posts.text: as an aquarius friend i'll disappear for four months without explanation and then turn up at your door with soup on the exact day your life falls apart
posts.caption: Detached, but somehow always on time

posts.text: terms and conditions of an aquarius: feelings may be discussed in theory only. hugs available on request with 48 hours notice. any attempt to predict us will void the agreement x
posts.caption: Fixed sign, unfixable vibe

posts.text: put me on a jury and i'll be the pisces who has fully forgiven the defendant, the plaintiff and the judge, and would like to know if anyone has checked on the stenographer
posts.caption: Reasonable doubt? Reasonable empathy.

posts.text: today's pisces forecast: heavy neptune fog rolling in by mid-morning, visibility reduced to whatever daydream you're having, with scattered showers whenever an advert features an old dog
posts.caption: Drive carefully. Feel everything.

posts.text: i regret to announce that my pisces moon has once again absorbed the emotions of a stranger on the train. i do not know her name, but i am going through her breakup x
posts.caption: Emotional sponge, no off switch

posts.text: very pisces venus of me to go on one date, name our future dog, design the wedding playlist and mourn the entire relationship before he's even texted back
posts.caption: Neptune writes fiction for free

posts.text: being a pisces means my two fish are permanently swimming in opposite directions. one wants to change the world, the other wants to lie in a dark room listening to rain
posts.caption: Mutable water, mixed agenda

posts.text: put me in the dmv and i'll be the pisces who forgot the forms, accidentally gave a stranger my ticket number, and still left with the employee's whole life story and a hug
posts.caption: Bureaucracy, but make it healing

posts.text: if we ever do a heist i'll be the pisces who was meant to be the lookout but got distracted by the moon, and now the security guard and i are best friends
posts.caption: Compromised, but emotionally enriched

posts.text: by royal decree of the pisces sun, all deadlines are hereby softened, all clocks are to be ignored, and naps are formally recognised as a legitimate form of spiritual research
posts.caption: The kingdom runs on Neptune time

posts.text: please be advised that your pisces coworker cannot help with the spreadsheet, but can tell from your 'morning' alone that something is going on at home and has bought you a muffin
posts.caption: Not psychic. Just Pisces.

posts.text: having a pisces rising means i walk into every room seeming like i'm contemplating something profound, when actually i'm planning my imaginary bakery in a seaside town
posts.caption: Mysterious, or mentally on holiday

posts.text: here we observe the pisces in its natural habitat, the bath, where it will remain for ninety minutes rehearsing an argument from 2019 that it has already won seven times in its head
posts.caption: Hydrated, imaginary and undefeated, as usual

posts.text: a mars in pisces doesn't fight you. it quietly forgives you, writes a sad song about it, and then that song goes to number one and your entire town knows what you did
posts.caption: Gentle anger has range

posts.text: take me to an art gallery and i'll be the pisces standing in front of one painting of a small boat for forty minutes because i know exactly how the boat feels
posts.caption: Neptune said relate to the boat

posts.text: as a pisces friend i will give you advice that is genuinely wise, deeply spiritual and life changing, and then do the exact opposite of it in my own life within the hour
posts.caption: Wise for others, Neptune for self

posts.text: invite me to a wedding and i'll be the pisces crying at the vows, the speeches, the first dance, and the moment the caterer said 'enjoy' with such sincerity
posts.caption: Weddings are a full emotional workout
